localContext: Palatine’s rolling-terrain subdivisions, often built between the 1970s and 1990s, feature many attached two-car garages. Many homes, particularly near Deer Grove, have driveways that slope towards the garage door. This design often causes water and ice to collect at the door’s bottom seal during winter. This leads to ice damming, where the door freezes to the concrete slab. Forcing an old opener in these conditions can strip gears or snap the trolley. A modern, strong opener is important here. Older openers in areas like Pepper Tree might not withstand these stresses. Newer openers offer more durable components and modern safety features, preventing unnecessary damage.
